title: Environment
definition: The complex of physical, chemical, and biotic factors that act upon an organism or an ecological community and ultimately determine its form and survival.

title: Interaction
definition: Mutual or reciprocal action or influence; the process by which things or people act upon each other.

title: Experience
definition: The practical wisdom, knowledge, or techne gained from what one has observed, encountered, or undergone in the course of lived reality.

title: Relationship
definition: The state of being mutually connected or related; the specific mode in which two or more people or things are connected and behave toward each other.

title: Belonging
definition: A secure feeling of acceptance, identification, and emotional attachment to a specific social collective, group, or institutional place.

title: Support
definition: The act of bearing the weight of, sustaining, or providing psychological, emotional, or practical assistance to maintain the well-being of another.

title: Context
definition: The interrelated conditions, background, or setting in which something exists or occurs, which essentializes the meaning of an event or action.

title: Commitment
definition: An agreement, pledge, or deliberate obligation to bind oneself to a certain course of action, person, or systemic practice over time.

title: Intimacy
definition: he state of having a very close personal, emotional, or private relationship with someone, characterized by psychological warmth and mutual vulnerability.

title: Passion
definition: An intense, driving, or overmastering feeling, conviction, or emotional investment directed toward a person, cause, or collective pursuit.
